news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.33 (vs ₹2.29 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.33 (down from ₹2.29 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹8.90b (down 14% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹629.9m (down 35% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.1% (down from 9.5% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 22% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 22% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 41% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
